pages.text: Laws as dynamical systems: the logistic map x → rx(1−x) doubles its period at r = 3, 3.449, 3.544... converging (Feigenbaum, δ = 4.669) on chaos at r∞ = 3.5699. A lattice of coupled laws synchronises only if the coupling beats the chaos: ε > 1 − e^(−λ).
$(thing)Set$(): Growth parameter r, Lattice coupling ε.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Law drift: r is r + 0.0002·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Laws not synchronised: the lattice tears into incoherent regions; r above 4: the map leaves the unit interval.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Simulations run at a fixed pace.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Bifurcation index: n ≈ ln((r∞ − 3)/(r∞ − r))/ln δ + 1$(br)Lyapunov exponent λ: λ ≈ 0.9(r − r∞)^0.45$(br)Synchronisation threshold: ε_c = 1 − e^(−λ)
